description: This file 'testutil.h' provides utility functions for testing TensorFlow C++ framework components, including functions to retrieve tensors and handle variable assignments within computational scopes.

methods.name: GetTensors
methods.description: Computes multiple tensors specified in 'tensors' within a given scope, returning the results in 'out'.

methods.name: GetTensors
methods.description: Computes multiple tensors with extra assign variables, returns the resulting tensors.

methods.name: GetTensor
methods.description: Computes a single tensor specified by 'tensor', returning the result in 'out'.

methods.name: GetTensor
methods.description: Computes a single tensor with optional assignment variables, returning the result in 'out'.
